scenario: Chain depth cap per LCCO.10.2 — a `call` with continuations nested inside an inner continuation body is rejected. Chains deeper than two outer/inner pairs require the two-sibling form per LCCO.10.4. Pin: a third-level continuation rejects with DS_VALIDATE_CONTINUATION_CHAIN_TOO_DEEP naming the offending call.
rules_ds:
schema SvcAReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.a:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcAReply

schema SvcBReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.b:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcBReply

schema SvcCReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service svc.c:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcCReply

schema TimeOfDay scope ttl 1_min:
    state: String

rule deep_chain:
    TimeOfDay t where t.state == "18:00"
->
    call svc.a entity_id: "x" cooldown: 1_min
        on response.code == 200:
            call svc.b entity_id: "y" cooldown: 1_min as "b"
                on response.code == 200:
                    call svc.c entity_id: "z" cooldown: 1_min as "c"
                        on response.code == 200:
                            log info "too deep"
